verses.en: The song of songs, which is Solomon's.
verses.fr: Cantique des cantiques, de Salomon.
verses.am: ከመዝሙር ሁሉ የሚበልጥ የሰሎሞን መዝሙር።

verses.en: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.
verses.fr: Qu''il me baise des baisers de sa bouche! Car ton amour vaut mieux que le vin,
verses.am: በአፉ መሳም ይሳመኝ፥ ፍቅርህ ከወይን ጠጅ ይልቅ መልካም ነውና።

verses.en: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.
verses.fr: Tes parfums ont une odeur suave; Ton nom est un parfum qui se répand; C''est pourquoi les jeunes filles t''aiment.
verses.am: ዘይትህ መልካም መዓዛ አለው፤ ስምህ እንደሚፈስስ ዘይት ነው፤ ስለዚህ ደናግል ወደዱህ።

verses.en: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.
verses.fr: Entraîne-moi après toi! Nous courrons! Le roi m''introduit dans ses appartements... Nous nous égaierons, nous nous réjouirons à cause de toi; Nous célébrerons ton amour plus que le vin. C''est avec raison que l''on t''aime.
verses.am: ሳበኝ፥ ከአንተም በኋላ እንሮጣለን፤ ንጉሡ ወደ ቤቱ አገባኝ በአንተ ደስ ይለናል፥ ሐሤትም እናደርጋለን፤ ከወይን ጠጅ ይልቅ ፍቅርህን እናስባለን፤ በቅንነት ይወድዱሃል።

verses.en: I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.
verses.fr: Je suis noire, mais je suis belle, filles de Jérusalem, Comme les tentes de Kédar, comme les pavillons de Salomon.
verses.am: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ እኔ ጥቁር ነኝ፤ ነገር ግን ውብ ነኝ፥ እንደ ቄዳር ድንኳኖች እንደ ሰሎሞንም መጋረጃዎች።

verses.en: Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.
verses.fr: Ne prenez pas garde à mon teint noir: C''est le soleil qui m''a brûlée. Les fils de ma mère se sont irrités contre moi, Ils m''ont faite gardienne des vignes. Ma vigne, à moi, je ne l''ai pas gardée.
verses.am: ፀሐይ መልኬን አክስሎታልና፤ ጥቁር ስለ ሆንሁ አትዩኝ፤ የእናቴ ልጆች ተጣሉኝ፥ የወይን ቦታዎችንም ጠባቂ አደረጉኝ፤ ነገር ግን የእኔን ወይን ቦታ አልጠበቅሁም።

verses.en: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?
verses.fr: Dis-moi, ô toi que mon coeur aime, Où tu fais paître tes brebis, Où tu les fais reposer à midi; Car pourquoi serais-je comme une égarée Près des troupeaux de tes compagnons? -
verses.am: ነፍሴ የወደደችህ አንተ ንገረኝ፤ ወዴት ታሰማራለህ? በቅትርስ ጊዜ ወዴት ትመስጋለህ? ስለ ምንስ ከባልንጀሮችህ መንጎች በኋላ እቅበዘበዛለሁ?

verses.en: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds' tents.
verses.fr: Si tu ne le sais pas, ô la plus belle des femmes, Sors sur les traces des brebis, Et fais paître tes chevreaux Près des demeures des bergers. -
verses.am: አንቺ በሴቶች ዘንድ የተዋብሽ ሆይ፥ ያላወቅሽ እንደ ሆነ የመንጎችን ፍለጋ ተከትለሽ ውጪ፥ የፍየል ግልገሎችሽንም በእረኞች ድንኳኖች አጠገብ አሰማሪ።

verses.en: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh's chariots.
verses.fr: A ma jument qu''on attelle aux chars de Pharaon Je te compare, ô mon amie.
verses.am: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ በፈርዖን ሰረገሎች እንዳለ ፈረስ መሰልሁሽ።

verses.en: Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains of gold.
verses.fr: Tes joues sont belles au milieu des colliers, Ton cou est beau au milieu des rangées de perles.
verses.am: የጕንጭሽ ውበት በከበረ ሉል፥ አንገትሽም በዕንቍ ድሪ ያማረ ነው።

verses.en: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.
verses.fr: Nous te ferons des colliers d''or, Avec des points d''argent. -
verses.am: ባለ ብር ጕብጕብ የሆነ የወርቅ ጠልሰም እናደርግልሻለን።

verses.en: While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
verses.fr: Tandis que le roi est dans son entourage, Mon nard exhale son parfum.
verses.am: ንጉሡ በማዕዱ ሳለ፥ የእኔ ናርዶስ መዓዛውን ሰጠ።

verses.en: A bundle of myrrh is my well-beloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
verses.fr: Mon bien-aimé est pour moi un bouquet de myrrhe, Qui repose entre mes seins.
verses.am: ውዴ ለእኔ በጡቶቼ መካከል እንደሚያርፍ እንደ ተቋጠረ ከርቤ ነው።

verses.en: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of Engedi.
verses.fr: Mon bien-aimé est pour moi une grappe de troëne Des vignes d''En-Guédi. -
verses.am: ውዴ ለእኔ በዓይንጋዲ ወይን ቦታ እንዳለ እንደ አበባ እቅፍ ነው።

verses.en: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves' eyes.
verses.fr: Que tu es belle, mon amie, que tu es belle! Tes yeux sont des colombes. -
verses.am: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ውብ ነሽ፤ እነሆ፥ አንቺ ውብ ነሽ፤ ዓይኖችሽም እንደ ርግቦች ናቸው።

verses.en: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.
verses.fr: Que tu es beau, mon bien-aimé, que tu es aimable! Notre lit, c''est la verdure. -
verses.am: ውዴ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ አንተ ውብ ነህ፥ መልከ መልካምም ነህ፤ አልጋችንም ለምለም ነው።

verses.en: The beams of our house are cedar, and our rafters of fir.
verses.fr: Les solives de nos maisons sont des cèdres, Nos lambris sont des cyprès. -
verses.am: የቤታችን ሰረገላ የዝግባ ዛፍ ነው፥ የጣሪያችንም ማዋቀሪያ የጥድ ዛፍ ነው።

verses.en: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.
verses.fr: Je suis un narcisse de Saron, Un lis des vallées. -
verses.am: እኔ የሳሮን ጽጌ ረዳ የቈላም አበባ ነኝ።

verses.en: As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
verses.fr: Comme un lis au milieu des épines, Telle est mon amie parmi les jeunes filles. -
verses.am: በእሾህ መካከል እንዳለ የሱፍ አበባ፥ እንዲሁ ወዳጄ በቈነጃጅት መካከል ናት።

verses.en: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.
verses.fr: Comme un pommier au milieu des arbres de la forêt, Tel est mon bien-aimé parmi les jeunes hommes. J''ai désiré m''asseoir à son ombre, Et son fruit est doux à mon palais.
verses.am: በዱር እንዳለ እንኮይ፥ እንዲሁ ውዴ በልጆች መካከል ነው። ከጥላው በታች እጅግ ወድጄ ተቀመጥሁ፥ ፍሬውም በጕሮሮዬ ጣፋጭ ነው።

verses.en: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.
verses.fr: Il m''a fait entrer dans la maison du vin; Et la bannière qu''il déploie sur moi, c''est l''amour.
verses.am: ወደ ወይን ጠጁም ቤት አገባኝ፥ በእኔ ላይ ያለው ዓላማውም ፍቅር ነው።

verses.en: Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I am sick of love.
verses.fr: Soutenez-moi avec des gâteaux de raisins, Fortifiez-moi avec des pommes; Car je suis malade d''amour.
verses.am: በዘቢብም አጽናኑኝ፥ በእንኮይ አበረታቱኝ፥ በፍቅሩ ተነድፌ ታምሜያለሁና።

verses.en: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.
verses.fr: Que sa main gauche soit sous ma tête, Et que sa droite m''embrasse! -
verses.am: ግራው ከራሴ በታች ናት፥ ቀኙም ታቅፈኛለች።

verses.en: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
verses.fr: Je vous en conjure, filles de Jérusalem, Par les gazelles et les biches des champs, Ne réveillez pas, ne réveillez pas l''amour, Avant qu''elle le veuille. -
verses.am: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ እርሱ እስኪፈልግ ድረስ፥ ፍቅርን እንዳታስነሱትና እንዳታነሣሡት በሚዳቋ በምድረ በዳም ዋላ አምላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.
verses.fr: C''est la voix de mon bien-aimé! Le voici, il vient, Sautant sur les montagnes, Bondissant sur les collines.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የውዴ ቃል! በተራሮች ላይ ሲዘልል፥ በኮረብቶችም ላይ ሲወረወር ይመጣል።

verses.en: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.
verses.fr: Mon bien-aimé est semblable à la gazelle Ou au faon des biches. Le voici, il est derrière notre mur, Il regarde par la fenêtre, Il regarde par le treillis.
verses.am: ውዴ ሚዳቋን ወይም የዋላን እምቦሳ ይመስላል፤ እነሆ፥ በመስኮቶች ሲጐበኝ፥ በዓይነ ርግብም ሲመለከት፥ እርሱ ከቅጥራችን በኋላ ቆሞአል።

verses.en: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.
verses.fr: Mon bien-aimé parle et me dit: Lève-toi, mon amie, ma belle, et viens!
verses.am: ውዴ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረኝ። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ተነሺ፤ ውበቴ ሆይ፥ ነዪ።

verses.en: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;
verses.fr: Car voici, l''hiver est passé; La pluie a cessé, elle s''en est allée.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ክረምት አለፈ፥ ዝናቡም አልፎ ሄደ።

verses.en: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
verses.fr: Les fleurs paraissent sur la terre, Le temps de chanter est arrivé, Et la voix de la tourterelle se fait entendre dans nos campagnes.
verses.am: አበቦች በምድር ላይ ተገለጡ፥ የዜማም ጊዜ ደረሰ፥ የቊርዬውም ቃል በምድራችን ተሰማ።

verses.en: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs, and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.
verses.fr: Le figuier embaume ses fruits, Et les vignes en fleur exhalent leur parfum. Lève-toi, mon amie, ma belle, et viens!
verses.am: በለሱ ጐመራ፥ ወይኖችም አበቡ መዓዛቸውንም ሰጡ፤ ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ተነሺ፤ ውበቴ ሆይ፥ ነዪ።

verses.en: O my dove, that art in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs, let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; for sweet is thy voice, and thy countenance is comely.
verses.fr: Ma colombe, qui te tiens dans les fentes du rocher, Qui te caches dans les parois escarpées, Fais-moi voir ta figure, Fais-moi entendre ta voix; Car ta voix est douce, et ta figure est agréable.
verses.am: በዓለት ንቃቃትና በገደል መሸሸጊያ ያለሽ ርግብ ሆይ፥ ቃልሽ መልካም ፊትሽም ያማረ ነውና መልክሽን አሳዪኝ፥ ድምፅሽንም አሰሚኝ።

verses.en: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
verses.fr: Prenez-nous les renards, Les petits renards qui ravagent les vignes; Car nos vignes sont en fleur.
verses.am: ወይናችን አብቦአልና የወይናችንን ቦታ የሚያጠፉትን ቀበሮች፥ ጥቃቅኑን ቀበሮች አጥምዳችሁ ያዙልን።

verses.en: My beloved is mine, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.
verses.fr: Mon bien-aimé est à moi, et je suis à lui; Il fait paître son troupeau parmi les lis.
verses.am: ውዴ የእኔ ነው፥ እኔም የእርሱ ነኝ፤ በሱፍ አበባዎች መካከልም መንጋውን ያሰማራል።

verses.en: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.
verses.fr: Avant que le jour se rafraîchisse, Et que les ombres fuient, Reviens!... sois semblable, mon bien-aimé, A la gazelle ou au faon des biches, Sur les montagnes qui nous séparent.
verses.am: ውዴ ሆይ፥ ቀኑ እስኪነፍስ፥ ጥላውም እስኪሸሽ ድረስ ተመለስ፤ በቅመም ተራራ ላይ ሚዳቋውን ወይም የዋላውን እምቦሳ ምሰል።

verses.en: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
verses.fr: Sur ma couche, pendant les nuits, J''ai cherché celui que mon coeur aime; Je l''ai cherché, et je ne l''ai point trouvé...
verses.am: ሌሊት በምንጣፌ ላይ ነፍሴ የወደደችውን ፈለግሁት፤ ፈለግሁት አላገኘሁትም።

verses.en: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
verses.fr: Je me lèverai, et je ferai le tour de la ville, Dans les rues et sur les places; Je chercherai celui que mon coeur aime... Je l''ai cherché, et je ne l''ai point trouvé.
verses.am: እነሣለሁ በከተማይቱም እዞራለሁ፥ ነፍሴ የወደደችውን በጎዳናና በአደባባይ እፈልጋለሁ፤ ፈለግሁት አላገኘሁትም።

verses.en: The watchmen that go about the city found me: to whom I said, Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?
verses.fr: Les gardes qui font la ronde dans la ville m''ont rencontrée: Avez-vous vu celui que mon coeur aime?
verses.am: ከተማይቱን የሚዞሩት ጠባቂዎች አገኙኝ፤ ነፍሴ የወደደችውን አያችሁትን? አልኋቸውም።

verses.en: It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.
verses.fr: A peine les avais-je passés, Que j''ai trouvé celui que mon coeur aime; Je l''ai saisi, et je ne l''ai point lâché Jusqu''à ce que je l''aie amené dans la maison de ma mère, Dans la chambre de celle qui m''a conçue. -
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጥቂት እልፍ ብዬ ነፍሴ የወደደችውን አገኘሁት፥ ያዝሁትም ወደ እናቴም ቤት ወደ ወላጅ እናቴም እልፍኝ እስካገባው ድረስ አልተውሁትም።

verses.en: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
verses.fr: Je vous en conjure, filles de Jérusalem, Par les gazelles et les biches des champs, Ne réveillez pas, ne réveillez pas l''amour, Avant qu''elle le veuille. -
verses.am: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ እርሱ እስኪፈልግ ድረስ፥ ፍቅርን እንዳታስነሡትና እንዳታነሣሡት በሚዳቋ በምድረ በዳም ዋላ አምላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?
verses.fr: Qui est celle qui monte du désert, Comme des colonnes de fumée, Au milieu des vapeurs de myrrhe et d''encens Et de tous les aromates des marchands? -
verses.am: መዓዛም እንደ ከርቤና እንደ ዕጣን የሆነችው፥ ከልዩ ከነጋዴ ቅመም ሁሉ የሆነችው፥ ይህች ከምድረ በዳ እንደ ጢስ ምስሶ የወጣችው ማን ናት?

verses.en: Behold his bed, which is Solomon's; threescore valiant men are about it, of the valiant of Israel.
verses.fr: Voici la litière de Salomon, Et autour d''elle soixante vaillants hommes, Des plus vaillants d''Israël.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የሰሎሞን አልጋ ናት፤ ከእስራኤል ኃያላን ስድሳ ኃያላን በዙሪያው ናቸው።

verses.en: They all hold swords, being expert in war: every man hath his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.
verses.fr: Tous sont armés de l''épée, Sont exercés au combat; Chacun porte l''épée sur sa hanche, En vue des alarmes nocturnes.
verses.am: ሁሉም ሰይፍ የያዙ ሰልፈኞች ናቸው፤ በሌሊት ከሚወድቀው ፍርሃት የተነሣ ሰው ሁሉ ሰይፉ በወገቡ አለ።

verses.en: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon s''est fait une litière De bois du Liban.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን መሸከሚያን ከሊባኖስ እንጨት ለራሱ አሠራ።

verses.en: He made the pillars thereof of silver, the bottom thereof of gold, the covering of it of purple, the midst thereof being paved with love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Il en a fait les colonnes d''argent, Le dossier d''or, Le siège de pourpre; Au milieu est une broderie, oeuvre d''amour Des filles de Jérusalem.
verses.am: ምሰሶቹን የብር፥ መደገፊያውንም የወርቅ፥ መቀመጫውንም ሐምራዊ ግምጃ አደረገ፤ ውስጡ በኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ፍቅር የተለበጠ ነው።

verses.en: Go forth, O ye daughters of Zion, and behold king Solomon with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.
verses.fr: Sortez, filles de Sion, regardez Le roi Salomon, Avec la couronne dont sa mère l''a couronné Le jour de ses fiançailles, Le jour de la joie de son coeur. -
verses.am: እናንተ የጽዮን ቈነጃጅት፥ ውጡ፤ እናቱ በሠርጉ ቀንና በልቡ ደስታ ቀን ያደረገችለትን አክሊል ደፍቶ ንጉሥ ሰሎሞንን እዩ።

verses.en: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves' eyes within thy locks: thy hair is as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead.
verses.fr: Que tu es belle, mon amie, que tu es belle! Tes yeux sont des colombes, Derrière ton voile. Tes cheveux sont comme un troupeau de chèvres, Suspendues aux flancs de la montagne de Galaad.
verses.am: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ እነሆ፥ ውብ ነሽ፤ እነሆ፥ አንቺ ውብ ነሽ፤ በዓይነ ርግብ መሸፈኛሽ ውስጥ ዓይኖችሽ እንደ ርግቦች ናቸው፤ ጠጕርሽ በገለዓድ ተራራ እንደሚወርድ እንደ ፍየል መንጋ ነው።

verses.en: Thy teeth are like a flock of sheep that are even shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none is barren among them.
verses.fr: Tes dents sont comme un troupeau de brebis tondues, Qui remontent de l''abreuvoir; Toutes portent des jumeaux, Aucune d''elles n''est stérile.
verses.am: ጥርሶችሽ ታጥበው እንደ ተሸለቱ ሁሉም መንታ እንደ ወለዱ ከእነርሱም መካን እንደሌለባቸው መንጎች ናቸው።

verses.en: Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely: thy temples are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.
verses.fr: Tes lèvres sont comme un fil cramoisi, Et ta bouche est charmante; Ta joue est comme une moitié de grenade, Derrière ton voile.
verses.am: ከንፈሮችሽ እንደ ቀይ ሐር ፈትል ናቸው፥ አፍሽም ያማረ ነው፤ በዓይነ ርግብ መሸፈኛሽ ውስጥ ጕንጭና ጕንጭሽ እንደ ተከፈለ ሮማን ናቸው።

verses.en: Thy neck is like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.
verses.fr: Ton cou est comme la tour de David, Bâtie pour être un arsenal; Mille boucliers y sont suspendus, Tous les boucliers des héros.
verses.am: አንገትሽ ለሰልፍ ዕቃ መስቀያ እንደ ተሠራው እንደ ዳዊት ግንብ ነው፤ ሺህ ጋሻ የኃያላንም መሣሪያ ሁሉ ተንጠልጥሎበታል።

verses.en: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.
verses.fr: Tes deux seins sont comme deux faons, Comme les jumeaux d''une gazelle, Qui paissent au milieu des lis.
verses.am: ሁለቱ ጡቶችሽ መንታ እንደ ተወለዱ፥ በሱፍ አበባ መካከል እንደሚሰማሩ እንደ ሚዳቋ ግልገሎች ናቸው።

verses.en: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.
verses.fr: Avant que le jour se rafraîchisse, Et que les ombres fuient, J''irai à la montagne de la myrrhe Et à la colline de l''encens.
verses.am: ቀኑ እስኪነፍስ ጥላውም እስኪያልፍ ድረስ፥ ወደ ከርቤው ተራራ ወደ ዕጣኑም ኮረብታ እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: Thou art all fair, my love; there is no spot in thee.
verses.fr: Tu es toute belle, mon amie, Et il n''y a point en toi de défaut.
verses.am: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ሁለንተናሽ ውብ ነው፥ ነውርም የለብሽም።

verses.en: Come with me from Lebanon, my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
verses.fr: Viens avec moi du Liban, ma fiancée, Viens avec moi du Liban! Regarde du sommet de l''Amana, Du sommet du Senir et de l''Hermon, Des tanières des lions, Des montagnes des léopards.
verses.am: ሙሽራዬ ሆይ፥ ከሊባኖስ ከእኔ ጋር ነዪ፤ ከሊባኖስ ከእኔ ጋር ነዪ፤ ከአማና ራስ ከሳኔርና ከኤርሞን ራስ፥ ከአንበሶች መኖሪያ ከነብሮችም ተራራ ተመልከች።

verses.en: Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister, my spouse; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck.
verses.fr: Tu me ravis le coeur, ma soeur, ma fiancée, Tu me ravis le coeur par l''un de tes regards, Par l''un des colliers de ton cou.
verses.am: እኅቴ ሙሽራ ሆይ፥ ልቤን በደስታ አሳበድሽው፤ አንድ ጊዜ በዓይኖችሽ፥ ከአንገትሽ ድሪ በአንዱ ልቤን በደስታ አሳበድሽው።

verses.en: How fair is thy love, my sister, my spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!
verses.fr: Que de charmes dans ton amour, ma soeur, ma fiancée! Comme ton amour vaut mieux que le vin, Et combien tes parfums sont plus suaves que tous les aromates!
verses.am: እኅቴ ሙሽራ ሆይ፥ ፍቅርሽ እንዴት መልካም ነው! ፍቅርሽ ከወይን ጠጅ ይልቅ እንዴት ይሻላል! የዘይትሽም መዓዛ ከሽቱ ሁሉ!

verses.en: Thy lips, O my spouse, drop as the honeycomb: honey and milk are under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon.
verses.fr: Tes lèvres distillent le miel, ma fiancée; Il y a sous ta langue du miel et du lait, Et l''odeur de tes vêtements est comme l''odeur du Liban.
verses.am: ሙሽራዬ ሆይ፥ ከከንፈሮችሽ ማር ይንጠበጠባል፤ ከምላስሽ በታች ማርና ወተት አለ፥ የልብስሽም መዓዛ እንደ ሊባኖስ ሽታ ነው።

verses.en: A garden inclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.
verses.fr: Tu es un jardin fermé, ma soeur, ma fiancée, Une source fermée, une fontaine scellée.
verses.am: እኅቴ ሙሽራ የተቈለፈ ገነት፥ የተዘጋ ምንጭ የታተመም ፈሳሽ ናት።

verses.en: Thy plants are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,
verses.fr: Tes jets forment un jardin, où sont des grenadiers, Avec les fruits les plus excellents, Les troënes avec le nard;
verses.am: ቡቃያሽ ሮማንና የተመረጠ ፍሬ፥ ቆዕ ከናርዶስ ጋር ያለበት ገነት ነው፥

verses.en: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:
verses.fr: Le nard et le safran, le roseau aromatique et le cinnamome, Avec tous les arbres qui donnent l''encens; La myrrhe et l''aloès, Avec tous les principaux aromates;
verses.am: ናርዶስ ከቀጋ ጋር፥ የሽቱ ሣርና ቀረፋ፥ ከልዩ ልዩ ዕጣን ጋር፥ ከርቤና እሬት ከክቡር ሽቱ ሁሉ ጋር።

verses.en: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.
verses.fr: Une fontaine des jardins, Une source d''eaux vives, Des ruisseaux du Liban.
verses.am: አንቺ የገነት ምንጭ፥ የሕይወት ውኃ ጕድጓድ፥ ከሊባኖስም የሚፈስስ ወንዝ ነሽ።

verses.en: Awake, O north wind; and come, thou south; blow upon my garden, that the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and eat his pleasant fruits.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, aquilon! viens, autan! Soufflez sur mon jardin, et que les parfums s''en exhalent! -Que mon bien-aimé entre dans son jardin, Et qu''il mange de ses fruits excellents! -
verses.am: የሰሜን ነፋስ ሆይ፥ ተነሥ፥ የደቡብም ነፋስ ና፤ በገነቴ ላይ ንፈስ፥ ሽቱውም ይፍሰስ፤ ውዴ ወደ ገነቱ ይግባ፥ መልካሙንም ፍሬ ይብላ።

verses.en: I am come into my garden, my sister, my spouse: I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk: eat, O friends; drink, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved.
verses.fr: J''entre dans mon jardin, ma soeur, ma fiancée; Je cueille ma myrrhe avec mes aromates, Je mange mon rayon de miel avec mon miel, Je bois mon vin avec mon lait... -Mangez, amis, buvez, enivrez-vous d''amour! -
verses.am: እኅቴ ሙሽራዬ ሆይ፥ ወደ ገነቴ ገባሁ፥ ከርቤዬን ከሽቱዬ ጋር ለቀምሁ፥ እንጀራዬን ከማሬ ጋር በላሁ፥ የወይን ጠጄን ከወተቴ ጋር ጠጣሁ። ባልንጀሮቼ ሆይ፥ ብሉ፤ ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ጠጪ፤ እስክትረኪ ድረስ ጠጪ።

verses.en: I sleep, but my heart waketh: it is the voice of my beloved that knocketh, saying, Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled: for my head is filled with dew, and my locks with the drops of the night.
verses.fr: J''étais endormie, mais mon coeur veillait... C''est la voix de mon bien-aimé, qui frappe: -Ouvre-moi, ma soeur, mon amie, Ma colombe, ma parfaite! Car ma tête est couverte de rosée, Mes boucles sont pleines des gouttes de la nuit. -
verses.am: እኔ ተኝቻለሁ፥ ልቤ ግን ነቅቶአል፤ የውዴ ቃል ነው፥ እርሱም ደጁን ይመታል፤ እኅቴ፥ ወዳጄ፥ ርግቤ፥ መደምደሚያዬ ሆይ፥ በራሴ ጠል፥ በቈንዳላዬም የሌሊት ነጠብጣብ ሞልቶበታልና ክፈችልኝ።

verses.en: I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?
verses.fr: J''ai ôté ma tunique; comment la remettrais-je? J''ai lavé mes pieds; comment les salirais-je?
verses.am: ቀሚሴን አወለቅሁ፤ እንዴት እለብሰዋለሁ? እግሬን ታጠብሁ፤ እንዴት አሳድፈዋለሁ?

verses.en: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, and my bowels were moved for him.
verses.fr: Mon bien-aimé a passé la main par la fenêtre, Et mes entrailles se sont émues pour lui.
verses.am: ውዴ እጁን በቀዳዳ ሰደደ፥ አንጀቴም ስለ እርሱ ታወከ።

verses.en: I rose up to open to my beloved; and my hands dropped with myrrh, and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh, upon the handles of the lock.
verses.fr: Je me suis levée pour ouvrir à mon bien-aimé; Et de mes mains a dégoutté la myrrhe, De mes doigts, la myrrhe répandue Sur la poignée du verrou.
verses.am: ለውዴ እከፍትለት ዘንድ ተነሣሁ፤ እጆቼ በደጅ መወርወሪያ ላይ ከርቤን አፈሰሱ፥ ጣቶቼ ፈሳሹን ከርቤ አንጠበጠቡ።

verses.en: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved had withdrawn himself, and was gone: my soul failed when he spake: I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.
verses.fr: J''ai ouvert à mon bien-aimé; Mais mon bien-aimé s''en était allé, il avait disparu. J''étais hors de moi, quand il me parlait. Je l''ai cherché, et je ne l''ai point trouvé; Je l''ai appelé, et il ne m''a point répondu.
verses.am: ለውዴ ከፈትሁለት፥ ውዴ ግን ፈቀቅ ብሎ አልፎ ነበር። ነፍሴ ከቃሉ የተነሣ ደነገጠች፤ ፈለግሁት፥ አላገኘሁትም፤ ጠራሁት፥ አልመለሰልኝም።

verses.en: The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.
verses.fr: Les gardes qui font la ronde dans la ville m''ont rencontrée; Ils m''ont frappée, ils m''ont blessée; Ils m''ont enlevé mon voile, les gardes des murs.
verses.am: ከተማይቱን የሚዞሩት ጠባቂዎች አገኙኝ፤ መቱኝ፥ አቈሰሉኝም፤ ቅጥር ጠባቂዎችም የዓይነ ርግብ መሸፈኛዬን ወሰዱት።

verses.en: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if ye find my beloved, that ye tell him, that I am sick of love.
verses.fr: Je vous en conjure, filles de Jérusalem, Si vous trouvez mon bien-aimé, Que lui direz-vous?... Que je suis malade d''amour. -
verses.am: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ አምላችኋለሁ፤ ውዴን ያገኛችሁት እንደ ሆነ፥ እኔ ከፍቅር የተነሣ መታመሜን ንገሩት።

verses.en: What is thy beloved more than another beloved, O thou fairest among women? what is thy beloved more than another beloved, that thou dost so charge us?
verses.fr: Qu''a ton bien-aimé de plus qu''un autre, O la plus belle des femmes? Qu''a ton bien-aimé de plus qu''un autre, Pour que tu nous conjures ainsi? -
verses.am: አንቺ በሴቶች ዘንድ የተዋብሽ ሆይ፥ ከሌላ ወዳጅ ይልቅ ውድሽ ማን ነው? ይህን የሚያህል አምለሽናልና ከሌላ ወዳጅ ይልቅ ውድሽ ማን ነው?

verses.en: My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.
verses.fr: Mon bien-aimé est blanc et vermeil; Il se distingue entre dix mille.
verses.am: ውዴ ነጭና ቀይ ነው፥ ከእልፍ የተመረጠ ነው።

verses.en: His head is as the most fine gold, his locks are bushy, and black as a raven.
verses.fr: Sa tête est de l''or pur; Ses boucles sont flottantes, Noires comme le corbeau.
verses.am: ራሱ ምዝምዝ ወርቅ ነው፤ ቈንዳላው የተዝረፈረፈ ነው፥ እንደ ቁራ ጥቁረትም ጥቁር ነው።

verses.en: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk, and fitly set.
verses.fr: Ses yeux sont comme des colombes au bord des ruisseaux, Se baignant dans le lait, Reposant au sein de l''abondance.
verses.am: ዓይኖቹ በሙሉ ፈሳሽ አጠገብ እንዳሉ በወተት እንደ ታጠቡ በፈሳሽ ውኃ አጠገብ እንደ ተቀመጡ እንደ ርግቦች ናቸው።

verses.en: His cheeks are as a bed of spices, as sweet flowers: his lips like lilies, dropping sweet smelling myrrh.
verses.fr: Ses joues sont comme un parterre d''aromates, Une couche de plantes odorantes; Ses lèvres sont des lis, D''où découle la myrrhe.
verses.am: ጕንጩና ጕንጩ የሽቱ መደብ እርከን እንዳለበት እንደ ሽቱ አትክልት ናቸው፤ ከንፈሮቹ እንደ አበቦች ናቸው፥ የሚፈስስ ከርቤንም ያንጠበጥባሉ።

verses.en: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl: his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires.
verses.fr: Ses mains sont des anneaux d''or, Garnis de chrysolithes; Son corps est de l''ivoire poli, Couvert de saphirs;
verses.am: እጆቹ የቢረሌ ፈርጥ እንዳለበት እንደ ወርቅ ቀለበት ናቸው፤ አካሉ ብልሃተኛ እንደ ሠራው በሰንፔር እንዳጌጠ እንደ ዝሆን ጥርስ ነው።

verses.en: His legs are as pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance is as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
verses.fr: Ses jambes sont des colonnes de marbre blanc, Posées sur des bases d''or pur. Son aspect est comme le Liban, Distingué comme les cèdres.
verses.am: እግሮቹ በምዝምዝ ወርቅ እንደ ተመሠረቱ እንደ ዕብነ በረድ ምሰሶች ናቸው፤ መልኩ እንደ ሊባኖስና እንደ ዝግባ ዛፍ መልካም ነው።

verses.en: His mouth is most sweet: yea, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Son palais n''est que douceur, Et toute sa personne est pleine de charme. Tel est mon bien-aimé, tel est mon ami, Filles de Jérusalem! -
verses.am: አፉ እጅግ ጣፋጭ ነው፥ እርሱም ፈጽሞ ያማረ ነው፤ እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ ውዴ ይህ ነው፥ ባልንጀራዬም ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.
verses.fr: Où est allé ton bien-aimé, O la plus belle des femmes? De quel côté ton bien-aimé s''est-il dirigé? Nous le chercherons avec toi.
verses.am: አንቺ በሴቶች ዘንድ የተዋብሽ ሆይ፥ ከአንቺ ጋር እንፈልገው ዘንድ ውድሽ ወዴት ሄደ? ውድሽስ ወዴት ፈቀቅ አለ?

verses.en: My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
verses.fr: Mon bien-aimé est descendu à son jardin, Au parterre d''aromates, Pour faire paître son troupeau dans les jardins, Et pour cueillir des lis.
verses.am: ውዴ በገነቱ መንጋውን ያሰማራ ዘንድ አበባውንም ይሰበስብ ዘንድ ወደ ሽቱ መደብ ወደ ገነቱ ወረደ።

verses.en: I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.
verses.fr: Je suis à mon bien-aimé, et mon bien-aimé est à moi; Il fait paître son troupeau parmi les lis. -
verses.am: እኔ የወዴ ነኝ ውዴም የእኔ ነው፤ በሱፉ አበባ መካከል መንጋውን ያሰማራል።

verses.en: Thou art beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, terrible as an army with banners.
verses.fr: Tu es belle, mon amie, comme Thirtsa, Agréable comme Jérusalem, Mais terrible comme des troupes sous leurs bannières.
verses.am: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ እንደ ቴርሳ ውብ ነሽ፥ እንደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ያማርሽ ነሽ፤ ዓላማ ይዞ እንደ ተሰለፈ ሠራዊት ታስፈሪያለሽ።

verses.en: Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair is as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead.
verses.fr: Détourne de moi tes yeux, car ils me troublent. Tes cheveux sont comme un troupeau de chèvres, Suspendues aux flancs de Galaad.
verses.am: አውከውኛልና ዓይኖችሽን ከፊቴ መልሺ፤ ጠጕርሽ ከገለዓድ እንደ ወረደ እንደ ፍየል መንጋ ነው።

verses.en: Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren among them.
verses.fr: Tes dents sont comme un troupeau de brebis, Qui remontent de l''abreuvoir; Toutes portent des jumeaux, Aucune d''elles n''est stérile.
verses.am: ጥርሶችሽ ታጥበው እንደ ወጡ ሁሉ መንታ እንደ ወለዱ ከእነርሱም መካን እንደሌለባቸው መንጎች ናቸው።

verses.en: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.
verses.fr: Ta joue est comme une moitié de grenade, Derrière ton voile...
verses.am: በዓይነ ርግብ መሸፈኛሽ ውስጥ ጕንጭና ጕንጭሽ እንደ ተከፈለ ሮማን ናቸው።

verses.en: There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.
verses.fr: Il y a soixante reines, quatre-vingts concubines, Et des jeunes filles sans nombre.
verses.am: ስድሳ ንግሥታት ሰማንያም ቍባቶች ቍጥር የሌላቸውም ቈነጃጅት አሉ።

verses.en: My dove, my undefiled is but one; she is the only one of her mother, she is the choice one of her that bare her. The daughters saw her, and blessed her; yea, the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.
verses.fr: Une seule est ma colombe, ma parfaite; Elle est l''unique de sa mère, La préférée de celle qui lui donna le jour. Les jeunes filles la voient, et la disent heureuse; Les reines et les concubines aussi, et elles la louent. -
verses.am: ርግቤ መደምደሚያዬም አንዲት ናት፤ ለእናትዋ አንዲት ናት ለወለደቻትም የተመረጠች ናት። ቈነጃጅትም አይተው አሞገሱአት፥ ንግሥታትና ቍባቶችም አመሰገኑአት።

verses.en: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners?
verses.fr: Qui est celle qui apparaît comme l''aurore, Belle comme la lune, pure comme le soleil, Mais terrible comme des troupes sous leurs bannières? -
verses.am: ይህች እንደ ማለዳ ብርሃን የምትጐበኝ፥ እንደ ጨረቃ የተዋበች እንደ ፀሐይም የጠራች፥ ዓላማ ይዞ እንደ ተሰለፈ ሠራዊት የምታስፈራ ማን ናት?

verses.en: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see whether the vine flourished and the pomegranates budded.
verses.fr: Je suis descendue au jardin des noyers, Pour voir la verdure de la vallée, Pour voir si la vigne pousse, Si les grenadiers fleurissent.
verses.am: የወንዙን ዳር ልምላሜ አይ ዘንድ፥ ወይኑ አብቦ ሮማኑም አፍርቶ እንደ ሆነ እመለከት ዘንድ ወደ ገውዝ ገነት ወረድሁ።

verses.en: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib.
verses.fr: Je ne sais, mais mon désir m''a rendue semblable Aux chars de mon noble peuple. -
verses.am: ሳላውቅ ነፍሴ በከበረው ሰረገላ ላይ አስቀመጠችኝ።

verses.en: Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.
verses.fr: Reviens, reviens, Sulamithe! Reviens, reviens, afin que nous te regardions. -Qu''avez-vous à regarder la Sulamithe Comme une danse de deux choeurs?
verses.am: ሱላማጢስ ተመለሺ ተመለሽ ተመለሽ እና እንይሽ በሱላማጢስ ላይ እንደ ሰፈሩ መቅሰፍት ምን ታያለሽ?

verses.en: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince's daughter! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.
verses.fr: Que tes pieds sont beaux dans ta chaussure, fille de prince! Les contours de ta hanche sont comme des colliers, Oeuvre des mains d''un artiste.
verses.am: አንቺ ሱላማጢስ ሆይ፥ ተመለሽ፥ ተመለሽ፤ እናይሽ ዘንድ ተመለሽ፥ ተመለሽ። በሱላማጢስ ምን ታያላችሁ? እርስዋ እንደ መሃናይም ዘፈን ናት።

verses.en: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.
verses.fr: Ton sein est une coupe arrondie, Où le vin parfumé ne manque pas; Ton corps est un tas de froment, Entouré de lis.
verses.am: አንቺ የመኰንን ልጅ ሆይ፥ እግሮችሽ በጫማ ውስጥ እንዴት ውቦች ናቸው! ዳሌዎችሽስ በአንጥረኛ እጅ እንደ ተሠሩ እንደ ዕንቍዎች ይመስላሉ።

verses.en: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.
verses.fr: Tes deux seins sont comme deux faons, Comme les jumeaux d''une gazelle.
verses.am: እንብርትሽ የወይን ጠጅ እንደማይጐድልበት እንደ ተነጠጠ ጽዋ ነው፤ ሆድሽ እንደ ስንዴ ክምር፥ በአበባም እንደ ታጠረ ነው።

verses.en: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bathrabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.
verses.fr: Ton cou est comme une tour d''ivoire; Tes yeux sont comme les étangs de Hesbon, Près de la porte de Bath-Rabbim; Ton nez est comme la tour du Liban, Qui regarde du côté de Damas.
verses.am: ሁለቱ ጡቶችሽ እንደ ሁለቱ መንታ እንደ ሚዳቋ ግለገሎች ናቸው።

verses.en: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king is held in the galleries.
verses.fr: Ta tête est élevée comme le Carmel, Et les cheveux de ta tête sont comme la pourpre; Un roi est enchaîné par des boucles!...
verses.am: አንገትሽ እንደ ዝሆን ጥርስ ግንብ ነው፤ ዓይኖችሽ በሐሴቦን ውስጥ በባትረቢ በር አጠገብ እንደ ውኃ ኵሬዎች ናቸው፤ አፍንጫሽ ወደ ደማስቆ አፋዛዥ እንደሚመለከት እንደ ሊባኖስ ግንብ ነው።

verses.en: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
verses.fr: Que tu es belle, que tu es agréable, O mon amour, au milieu des délices!
verses.am: ራስሽ እንደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ በላይሽ ነው፤ የራስሽም ጠጕር እንደ ሐምራዊ ሐር ነው፤ ንጉሡ በሹርባው ታስሮአል።

verses.en: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.
verses.fr: Ta taille ressemble au palmier, Et tes seins à des grappes.
verses.am: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ እንዴት የተዋብሽ ነሽ! እንዴትስ ደስ ታሰኛለሽ!

verses.en: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;
verses.fr: Je me dis: Je monterai sur le palmier, J''en saisirai les rameaux! Que tes seins soient comme les grappes de la vigne, Le parfum de ton souffle comme celui des pommes,
verses.am: ይህ ቁመትሽ የዘንባባ ዛፍ ይመስላል፥ ጡቶችሽም የወይን ዘለላ ይመስላሉ።

verses.en: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.
verses.fr: Et ta bouche comme un vin excellent,... -Qui coule aisément pour mon bien-aimé, Et glisse sur les lèvres de ceux qui s''endorment!
verses.am: ወደ ዘንባባው ዛፍ እወጣለሁ ጫፎችዋንም እይዛለሁ አልሁ፤ ጡቶችሽ እንደ ወይን ዘለላ የአፍንጫሽም ሽቱ እንደ እንኮይ ናቸው።

verses.en: I am my beloved's, and his desire is toward me.
verses.fr: Je suis à mon bien-aimé, Et ses désirs se portent vers moi.
verses.am: ጕሮሮሽ ለወዳጄ እየጣፈጠ እንደሚገባ፥ የተኙትን ከንፈሮች ይናገሩ ዘንድ እንደሚያደርግ፥ እንደ ማለፊያ የወይን ጠጅ ነው።

verses.en: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.
verses.fr: Viens, mon bien-aimé, sortons dans les champs, Demeurons dans les villages!
verses.am: እኔ የውዴ ነኝ፥ የእርሱም ምኞት ወደ እኔ ነው።

verses.en: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.
verses.fr: Dès le matin nous irons aux vignes, Nous verrons si la vigne pousse, si la fleur s''ouvre, Si les grenadiers fleurissent. Là je te donnerai mon amour.
verses.am: ውዴ ሆይ፥ ና፥ ወደ መስክ እንውጣ በመንደሮችም እንደር።

verses.en: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
verses.fr: Les mandragores répandent leur parfum, Et nous avons à nos portes tous les meilleurs fruits, Nouveaux et anciens: Mon bien-aimé, je les ai gardés pour toi.
verses.am: ወደ ወይኑ ቦታ ማልደን እንሂድ፤ ወይኑ አብቦ አበባውም ፍሬ አንዠርግጎ ሮማኑም አፍርቶ እንደ ሆነ እንይ፤ በዚያ ውዴን እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: O that thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.
verses.fr: Oh! Que n''es-tu mon frère, Allaité des mamelles de ma mère! Je te rencontrerais dehors, je t''embrasserais, Et l''on ne me mépriserait pas.
verses.am: አንተ የእናቴን ጡት እንደ ጠባ እንደ ወንድሜ ምነው በሆንህ! በሜዳ ባገኘሁህ ጊዜ በሳምሁህ፥ ማንም ባልናቀኝም ነበር።

verses.en: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother's house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.fr: Je veux te conduire, t''amener à la maison de ma mère; Tu me donneras tes instructions, Et je te ferai boire du vin parfumé, Du moût de mes grenades.
verses.am: መርቼ ወደ እናቴ ቤት ባገባሁህ፥ በዚያም አንተ ባስተማርከኝ፤ እኔም ከመልካሙ ወይን ጠጅ ከሮማኔም ውኃ ባጠጣሁህ ነበር።

verses.en: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
verses.fr: Que sa main gauche soit sous ma tête, Et que sa droite m''embrasse! -
verses.am: ግራው ከራሴ በታች በሆነች ቀኙም ባቀፈችኝ ነበር።

verses.en: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.
verses.fr: Je vous en conjure, filles de Jérusalem, Ne réveillez pas, ne réveillez pas l''amour, Avant qu''elle le veuille. -
verses.am: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ቈነጃጅት ሆይ፥ እርሱ እስኪፈልግ ድረስ ፍቅርን እንዳታስነሡት እንዳታነሣሡትም አምላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.
verses.fr: Qui est celle qui monte du désert, Appuyée sur son bien-aimé? -Je t''ai réveillée sous le pommier; Là ta mère t''a enfantée, C''est là qu''elle t''a enfantée, qu''elle t''a donné le jour. -
verses.am: በውድዋ ላይ ተደግፋ ከምድረ በዳ የምትወጣ ይህች ማን ናት? ከእንኮይ በታች አስነሣሁህ፤ በዚያ እናትህ ወለደችህ፥ በዚያም ወላጅ እናትህ አማጠችህ።

verses.en: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
verses.fr: Mets-moi comme un sceau sur ton coeur, Comme un sceau sur ton bras; Car l''amour est fort comme la mort, La jalousie est inflexible comme le séjour des morts; Ses ardeurs sont des ardeurs de feu, Une flamme de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንደ ማኅተም በልብህ፥ እንደ ማኅተም በክንድህ አኑረኝ፤ ፍቅር እንደ ሞት የበረታች ናትና፥ ቅንዓትም እንደ ሲኦል የጨከነች ናትና። ፍንጣሪዋ እንደ እሳት ፍንጣሪ፥ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ነበልባል ነው።

verses.en: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
verses.fr: Les grandes eaux ne peuvent éteindre l''amour, Et les fleuves ne le submergeraient pas; Quand un homme offrirait tous les biens de sa maison contre l''amour, Il ne s''attirerait que le mépris.
verses.am: ብዙ ውኃ ፍቅርን ያጠፋት ዘንድ አይችልም፥ ፈሳሾችም አያሰጥሙአትም፤ ሰው የቤቱን ሀብት ሁሉ ስለ ፍቅር ቢሰጥ ፈጽሞ ይንቁታል።

verses.en: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
verses.fr: Nous avons une petite soeur, Qui n''a point encore de mamelles; Que ferons-nous de notre soeur, Le jour où on la recherchera?
verses.am: እኛ ጡት የሌላት ታናሽ እኅት አለችን፤ ስለ እርስዋ በሚናገሩባት ቀን ለእኅታችን ምን እናድርግላት?

verses.en: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
verses.fr: Si elle est un mur, Nous bâtirons sur elle des créneaux d''argent; Si elle est une porte, Nous la fermerons avec une planche de cèdre. -
verses.am: እርስዋ ቅጥር ብትሆን የብር ግንብ በላይዋ እንሠራለን፤ ደጅም ብትሆን በዝግባ ሳንቃ እንከብባታለን።

verses.en: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
verses.fr: Je suis un mur, Et mes seins sont comme des tours; J''ai été à ses yeux comme celle qui trouve la paix.
verses.am: እኔ ቅጥር ነኝ ጡቶቼም እንደ ግንብ ናቸው፤ በዚያን ጊዜ በፊቱ ሰላምን እንደምታገኝ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Solomon had a vineyard at Baalhamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.
verses.fr: Salomon avait une vigne à Baal-Hamon; Il remit la vigne à des gardiens; Chacun apportait pour son fruit mille sicles d''argent.
verses.am: ለሰሎሞን በብኤላሞን የወይን ቦታ ነበረው፤ የወይኑን ቦታ ለጠባቂዎች አከራየው፤ ሰው ሁሉ ለፍሬው ሺህ ብር ያመጣለት ነበር።

verses.en: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
verses.fr: Ma vigne, qui est à moi, je la garde. A toi, Salomon, les mille sicles, Et deux cents à ceux qui gardent le fruit! -
verses.am: ለእኔ ያለኝ የወይን ቦታ በፊቴ ነው፤ ሰሎሞን ሆይ፥ ሺሁ ለአንተ፥ ሁለት መቶውም ፍሬውን ለሚጠብቁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.
verses.fr: Habitante des jardins! Des amis prêtent l''oreille à ta voix. Daigne me la faire entendre! -
verses.am: በገነቱ የምትቀመጪ ሆይ፥ ባልንጀሮች የአንቺን ቃል ያደምጣሉ፤ ቃልሽን አሰሚኝ።

verses.en: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
verses.fr: Fuis, mon bien-aimé! Sois semblable à la gazelle ou au faon des biches, Sur les montagnes des aromates!
verses.am: ውዴ ሆይ፥ ፍጠን፤ በቅመም ተራራ ላይ ሚዳቋን ወይም የዋላን እምቦሳ ምሰል።
